description: Every dependency moves through a pull request the gate has to pass. Nothing merges by itself: a catalog image is an app people's data lives in.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One pull request for the Rust crates and one for the interface's, minor and patch: forty separate ones would not be read.
Below 1.0 a minor is a breaking release, and the group compiles only if every one of its updates does: such an update gets its own pull request.
A RustCrypto release moves the traits its crates share (`digest`, `cipher`): hmac without sha2, or aes without cbc, does not compile.

Held until `rsa` 0.10 is released: rsa 0.9 is built on digest 0.10 and rand_core 0.6, and Bitwarden's client cryptography and hlb-types' seeded RSA key go through both. rsa's own pull request is the one that lifts this.
age 0.12 pulls p256 0.13, whose crypto-bigint 0.5 carries RUSTSEC-2026-0387 with no fixed release. Lift once age is on p256 0.14.
A catalog app is rehearsed before its version moves: one pull request per app, holding every image its manifest names — a companion moves with its app, never apart.
Its refs are branches (`stable`, `1.94.0`), which Renovate's tag lookup cannot read; and the MSRV's must never move by itself.

Over 60,000 tags on ghcr (a variant per accelerator, a build per pull request): Renovate's lookup gives up. Immich requires it at the server's exact version, so the server's pull request says to move it by hand.

prBodyNotes: 🔴 Move `immich-machine-learning` to the same tag, with its digest, in this pull request: Immich refuses a machine-learning service of another version, and Renovate cannot look it up.

customManagers.description: The catalog names each image as { repo, tag, digest } on one line; `hlb catalog validate` refuses a tag and digest that disagree.
